observation: Fresh main authority receipts derive policyDigest and materializedDigest only through crypto SHA-256 hex output, but the durable receipt boundary and public v0.1 contract still accept arbitrary strings. A persisted authority receipt can therefore claim digest representations that its own writer never emits.
changes: Constrain policyDigest to null or lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 and materializedDigest to absent/null or the same existing writer format.
Publish the same digest shape in the authority receipt v0.1 contract without changing RCL authority actions, approval modes, signing, trust roots, or policy semantics.

verification.cases: Rejects short, uppercase, non-hex and wrong-width digest representations; accepts and persists lowercase 64-hex writer-compatible values.

truth_boundary: This verifies digest representation parity only. It does not prove that a durable receipt's digest is cryptographically bound to an independently trusted policy artifact or signer.
